GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (16 Sep 46) LS-R
(SCAPIN-1205)
APO 500
16 September 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Recapture of Escaped War Crimes Suspect.
1. Information has been received that KITADA., Kintaro, Civilian, who was released from Sugamo Prison for transfer to Singapore, escaped from custody near KYOTO, while enroute by train on the morning of 3 September 1946.
2. It is directed that the Imperial Japanese Government immediately institute a search for, apprehend, and deliver this individual to the Commanding General, Eighth Army, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp). General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers will be kept informed of the progress of the search.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
